exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-10-21T12:00:00Z
mkdir source destination
exec card --store $WORK/source init --no-config --prefix src- --board-name Seed
exec card --store $WORK/source board create Source
exec card --store $WORK/destination init --no-config --prefix dst- --board-name Existing

# Clone is the only board transfer command.
exec card --store $WORK/source board --help
stdout 'board clone'
! stdout 'board copy'
! stderr .
! exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board copy --to-store $WORK/destination
stderr 'error: unexpected argument copy'
! stdout .

# Establish deterministic public IDs, then enable independent allocation.
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source config set --scope board issue.id.strategy sequential
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source create 'Shared issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/issue.txt
! exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board clone --to-store $WORK/destination
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/sequential.txt
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source config set --scope board issue.id.strategy random
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source state set src-1 'Shared State' --next 'Continue'
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source claim src-1

# Same-store aliases are rejected before importing anything.
! exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board clone --to-store $WORK/source/.
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/same-store.txt

exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board clone --to-store $WORK/destination
stdout 'cloned board "Source" as board_[0-9a-f]+ in project project_00000000000000000000: 1 issue, [0-9]+ mutations, 0 blobs'
! stderr .

# A new process verifies a replica with retained history but no local writer tip.
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Source state show src-1
stdout 'Shared State'
stdout 'Continue'
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Source claim src-1
! stderr .
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Source edit src-1 --title 'Destination edit'
! stderr .
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source show src-1
stdout 'Shared issue'
! stdout 'Destination edit'
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Source show src-1
stdout 'Destination edit'

# Clone is creation, not refresh or an idempotent copy receipt.
! exec card --store $WORK/source --board Source board clone --to-store $WORK/destination
stderr 'destination already contains board.*clone does not update an existing replica'
! stdout .

-- golden/issue.txt --
src-1
-- golden/sequential.txt --
error: source board uses sequential issue IDs; cloning requires adaptive-random IDs
-- golden/same-store.txt --
error: source and destination stores are the same physical store
